schema.name: USG Neutral Building Specification
schema.purpose: Software-neutral machine-readable description of Building 002 reconstructed from a hand sketch and user confirmations. Intended to let another AI generate concept geometry without access to the original conversation.

evidence_classes.exact: Explicitly dimensioned in the sketch or directly confirmed by the user. Binding.
evidence_classes.derived: Mathematically derived from exact information without adding unsupported design intent. Binding.
evidence_classes.observed: Presence or topology is visible in the sketch, but exact geometry is not fully dimensioned.
evidence_classes.approximate: Geometry may be reconstructed proportionally from the sketch for concept output only.
evidence_classes.ambiguous: More than one materially different interpretation remains possible.
evidence_classes.unknown: No reliable information exists; leave unresolved.
evidence_classes.user_accepted: Value proposed or proportionally inferred by AI and explicitly accepted by the author; binding for the current design state but not promoted to source fact.

schema.core_rule: Dimensions override proportion. Source notation such as ~ or ca. forces approximate evidence. Conflicts between source annotation and later confirmation remain unresolved until author review. Every dimension must be bound to a host element and, where relevant, specific edge(s).

project.name: Sketch Building 002
project.source: Hand sketch supplied by the user on 2026-10-26, showing plan and perspective on one sheet
project.revision: v0.2 after Revit reconstruction and three author visual reviews

source_artifacts.description: Original Building 002 plan + perspective sketch dated 2026-10-26
source_artifacts.availability_rule: Must travel with or remain resolvable from this neutral spec for audit/reconstruction.

source_artifacts.description: Revit concept-model review session on 2026-10-26/27; source of corrections encoded in v0.2.

origin.location: top-left corner of the lower rectangular plan as drawn

coordinate_system.note: Sketch axes are local drawing coordinates only and must not be interpreted as geographic directions.

level_height_mm.source: 3.0 m sketch dimension confirmed by user as level height

upper_roof_top_level_mm.source: 6.0 m sketch dimension confirmed by user as second-level roof-top elevation

flat_roof_overhang_mm.source: 1.0 m sketch annotation confirmed by author
flat_roof_overhang_mm.edges: upper flat roof edge(s) as shown; lower box has no overhang
flat_roof_overhang_mm.binding_note: Do not apply this value to the lower roof/terrace slab.

glazing_segment_width_mm.source: sketch annotation reads approximately 1.5 m segments (~1,5 m)
glazing_segment_width_mm.conflict_history: v0.1 incorrectly carried 1000 mm as exact from confirmation; source approximation governs after review correction.

footprint.placement_relative_to_lower_box: Overlaps the lower box and extends beyond it to the right. Exact XY offset remains to be dimensioned or proportionally reconstructed from the source sketch.

upper_box.support_relation: Supported at its four corners by columns running continuously from ground elevation 0 to upper roof elevation 6000.
upper_box.rule: Preserve the 10 x 7 m size and overlap/extension topology. Do not place the upper box simply centered/on top of the lower box.

roof_terrace.description: Accessible roof terrace on top of level 1 in the area not occupied by the overlapping upper box. The observed railing runs around the terrace edge.

guard_or_railing.rule: Do not invent a code-compliant guard height unless generating an explicitly labeled visualization hypothesis.

lower_box.logic: one marker at each corner of the lower box
lower_box.coordinate_note: Coordinates represent column marker centers at lower-box corners for neutral concept reconstruction.

upper_box.logic: one column at each corner of the 10 x 7 m upper box; columns run continuously from ground to upper roof
upper_box.coordinate_note: XY coordinates depend on the still-unresolved upper-box offset; Z base/top are confirmed 0/6000.

glazing.layout: equal panels within a solid framed lower facade
glazing.rule: Do not treat the facade as an all-glass curtain wall. Preserve corner piers, head band, recess, and floor-to-head glazing composition.

stairs.location_description: Along the top edge of the plan near the upper middle/right area.
stairs.role: Access from level 1 to roof terrace/upper level.
stairs.rule: Derive geometry from 1000 mm width, +x rise direction, 3000 mm level change, and max 8 risers per flight with landing; do not invent a different stair typology.

internal_core_or_wall.location_description: Near stair in upper middle-right portion of plan.

roofs.interpretation_note: Earlier sloping-roof reading was a perspective-convergence error. Perspective alone must not establish roof slope.

features: 10 x 7 m upper volume overlapping lower box and extending to the right
solid framed lower facade with recessed floor-to-head glazing
eight 300 x 300 mm corner columns total
upper flat roof with 1 m overhang

unresolved.item: exact XY offset / polygon coordinates of 10 x 7 m upper box
unresolved.impact: controls exact upper-column XY coordinates and terrace residual area

unresolved.item: exact edges receiving the 1 m upper-roof overhang if not all edges
exact facade panel count and residual end-panel handling for ~1.5 m modules
exact railing post spacing and rail heights
exact stair riser/tread dimensions and landing length
external/internal wall assemblies and material specifications

generation_contract.intended_output: concept 3D model such as STL/OBJ/GLB/Revit concept
hard_rules: Preserve the lower box at 10000 x 8000 mm and level height 3000 mm.
Preserve the upper box at 10000 x 7000 mm, overlapping the lower box and extending beyond it to the right.
Preserve the upper roof-top elevation at 6000 mm.
Use eight 300 x 300 mm column markers: four lower-box corners and four upper-box corners.
Upper-box corner columns run continuously from ground elevation 0 to roof elevation 6000 mm.
Upper roof is flat and carries the 1000 mm overhang; lower roof/terrace slab has no overhang.
Lower facade is a solid frame with corner piers and head band around recessed floor-to-head glazing; do not replace with a generic curtain wall.
Glazing panels are approximately 1500 mm equal segments and must remain tagged approximate.
Railing typology is three horizontal rails on sparse posts.
Stair width is 1000 mm, rises in +x, and may have no more than 8 risers per flight before a landing.
Preserve source artifacts or resolvable source references with the handoff.
Every dimension must identify its host; edge-specific dimensions must identify relevant edges.
Do not promote perspective-derived form to exact geometry without confirmation.
Do not silently resolve source/confirmation conflicts.
allowed_approximation: exact XY offset of the 10 x 7 m upper box may be proportionally estimated from the source if clearly tagged approximate
exact upper-column XY coordinates follow the chosen upper-box placement and inherit its evidence state
glazing panel count/end residuals may be proportionally resolved around the ~1500 mm module
railing post spacing and heights may use user-accepted concept values while retaining user_accepted provenance
stair tread/riser proportions and landing length may be derived under the functional constraints

required_metadata_on_export.subject: design_hypothesis
must_list: all unresolved source items not built
all user_accepted values and their provenance
source/confirmation conflicts and their resolution status

success_criteria: A human viewing the model should recognize the same two-level composition shown in the sketch.
The lower 10 x 8 m box, upper 10 x 7 m overlap topology, level heights, roof terrace, eight-column logic, approximately 1.5 m glazing rhythm and upper 1 m overhang must be preserved.
Any guessed geometry must remain identifiable as approximate or user_accepted in the export metadata.

usg_state.human_acceptance_required_before: promotion of approximate geometry beyond concept-hypothesis status

corner_piers.note: Accepted proportional concept value; not source fact.

head_band.note: Accepted proportional concept value from review; preserve as user-accepted, not sketch-exact.

review_checklist_before_acceptance: massing and relative placement of lower and upper boxes

revision_history.event: initial neutral spec from sketch and confirmations
corrected after Revit generation and author visual review
